final_message: PJR-V96B implemented and verified: plain IDs in `pipeline.parent_validations` still run in the project repository, and `{ id, repo }` runs the same fixed argv in the named repository's task worktree. Validations run even when that repository has no changes. A validation assigned to a repository without a worktree fails without spawning. The runner records `repo` on its evidence validations when the task has product repositories or a `{ id, repo }` entry is used, so evidence for projects without `repos` keeps its old shape. Logs, block reasons and reporter-resume matching use `<repo>:<id>` labels. Updated the exec-defaults schema (`{ id, repo }` items) and the exec-evidence schema (`repo`). Kept the fixed allowlist and decided not to add per-repo script names: product repositories must provide the same npm script names (documented in exec-config-guide). Added unit tests for two product repositories (app1, app2) running different validations in their own worktrees, plus regression tests for configurations without `repos`. Updated the ticket's work table and 対応結果 section without changing its status fields. Did not modify `.specdojo/exec-defaults.yaml` or `package.json`. Verified: src/exec-parent-validation.ts, src/exec-run.ts, src/exec-trial.ts, src/exec-evidence.ts, src/exec-agent-config.ts, both schemas, exec-config-guide.md, the ticket and 3 test files (formatting, markdownlint, catalog validate, index build). Unverified: typecheck, lint-ts/fm/md, test-unit, test-integration and validate-schema were not run here; they are left to the parent runner.
